<!--
Criterion B (parts 1 of 2): B1 — Extent of Occurrence

This file produces (in render order):
  1. criterion_b_setup       — helpers + assessment_map (visible to b2_aoo.Rmd too)
  2. ### Subcriterion summary
     criterion_b_summary     — callout box with B1 + B2 status circles
  3. ### Subcriterion B1 — Extent of Occurrence (EOO)
     intro paragraph (unchanged from before)
     b1_detail               — single-row card (replaces the old DT table)
     b1_map                  — leaflet (HTML) / ggplot (Word), unchanged from before
-->

```{r criterion_b_setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helpers for the Criterion B section.  worst_from / as_status_code /
# status_circle / status_palette already exist if criterion_a.Rmd ran first
# (which it does in the parent), but we redefine defensively in case b1_eoo.Rmd
# is knit standalone.

if (!exists("as_status_code")) {
  as_status_code <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1]) || !nzchar(as.character(x[1]))) "NE"
    else as.character(x[1])
  }
}

if (!exists("status_circle")) {
  status_circle <- function(x) {
    code <- as_status_code(x)
    if (isTRUE(knitr::is_html_output())) {
      sprintf('<span class="status-circle %s">%s</span>', code, code)
    } else {
      sprintf("[%s]", code)
    }
  }
}

if (!exists("status_palette")) {
  status_palette <- c(CR = "#FF0000", EN = "#FFA500", VU = "#FFFF00",
                      NT = "#ADFF2F", LC = "#008000", NE = "#999999")
}

# Used by b2_aoo.Rmd's b2_text chunk too — defined here because b1 renders first.
assessment_map <- c(
  "VU" = "Vulnerable",
  "EN" = "Endangered",
  "LC" = "Least Concern",
  "CR" = "Critically Endangered",
  "NT" = "Near Threatened"
)

# Pull the latest-year row from a B-style data frame (must have a `year` column).
latest_b_row <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (!"year" %in% names(df)) return(df[nrow(df), , drop = FALSE])
  df[which.max(as.numeric(df$year)), , drop = FALSE]
}

b1_latest <- latest_b_row(params$mcp_data)
b2_latest <- latest_b_row(params$b2_data)
has_any_b <- !is.null(b1_latest) || !is.null(b2_latest)
```


### Restricted geographic distribution - subcriteria summary
```{r criterion_b_summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = isTRUE(has_any_b)}
# Callout box with B1 + B2 status circles, mirroring criterion_a_summary.
# Status for each is the assessment recorded for the most recent year.

# tags$b("Subcriterion summary")

b1_status <- as_status_code(if (!is.null(b1_latest)) b1_latest$assessment else NA)
b2_status <- as_status_code(if (!is.null(b2_latest)) b2_latest$assessment else NA)

summary_subtitle <- "Based on the most recent distribution map"


if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(
      style = paste(
        "margin: 10px 0 20px 0;",
        "padding: 14px 16px;",
        "border: 1px solid #ddd;",
        "border-radius: 6px;",
        "background: #fafafa;"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-bottom: 10px;",
        htmltools::tags$b("Subcriterion outcomes"),
        htmltools::tags$span(
          paste0(" \u2014 ", summary_subtitle),
          style = "color: #666; font-size: 0.9em;"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-top: 6px;",
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(b1_status)), " ",
        htmltools::tags$b("B1"),
        " \u2014 Extent of Occurrence (EOO)"
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        style = "margin-top: 6px;",
        htmltools::HTML(status_circle(b2_status)), " ",
        htmltools::tags$b("B2"),
        " \u2014 Area of Occupancy (AOO)"
      )
    )
  )
} else {
  # Word: HTML divs / CSS don't render, so fall back to a coloured flextable.
  b_summary <- data.frame(
    Subcriterion = c("B1", "B2"),
    Description  = c("Extent of Occurrence (EOO)", "Area of Occupancy (AOO)"),
    Status       = c(b1_status, b2_status),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  ft <- flextable::flextable(b_summary)
  for (st in names(status_palette)) {
    rows_st <- which(b_summary$Status == st)
    if (length(rows_st) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::bg(ft, j = "Status", i = rows_st, bg = status_palette[[st]])
    }
  }
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(
    ft,
    caption = flextable::as_paragraph(
      flextable::as_b("Subcriterion outcomes "),
      paste0("\u2014 ", summary_subtitle)
    )
  )
  flextable::autofit(flextable::theme_booktabs(ft, bold_header = TRUE))
}
```


### Subcriterion B1 — Extent of Occurrence (EOO)

Subcriterion B1 is assessed by estimating the minimum convex polygon (MCP) — the smallest polygon that encompasses all known occurrences of the ecosystem. This method is consistent regardless of the resolution of the ecosystem classification maps, allowing comparison across global ecosystem types.

```{r a_text_missing, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = is.null(b1_latest)}
cat(paste0(
  "The extent of occurrence (EOO) under subcriterion B1 was not assessed for this ecosystem. "
))
```

```{r b1_text, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = !is.null(b1_latest)}
b1_eoo <- format(round(as.numeric(b1_latest$area_km2), 0),big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)

cat(paste0(
  "From the most recent mapping, the EOO for the ",
  params$ecosystem_name, " ecosystem is **", b1_eoo, " km^2^**. ",
  "This area classes the ecosystem as **",
  assessment_map[as.character(b1_latest$assessment)], "** under subcriterion B1."
))
```

```{r b1_detail, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(b1_latest)}
# Single-row "card" for B1: status circle, year, EOO area, category.
# Mirrors criterion_a_detail visually but with B1's columns.

b1_row <- data.frame(
  Year     = as.character(b1_latest$year),
  EOO      = paste0(format(round(as.numeric(b1_latest$area_km2), 0),
                           big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " km\u00b2"),
  Category = assessment_map[as.character(b1_latest$assessment)],
  Status   = as.character(b1_latest$assessment),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # Columns: status (60px) | year (90px) | EOO (160px) | category (flex)
  grid_cols <- "60px 90px 160px 1fr"
  
  header_row <- htmltools::div(
    style = sprintf(paste(
      "display: grid;",
      "grid-template-columns: %s;",
      "gap: 12px;",
      "align-items: center;",
      "padding: 6px 14px;",
      "color: #666;",
      "font-size: 0.82em;",
      "text-transform: uppercase;",
      "letter-spacing: 0.04em;",
      "border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;"
    ), grid_cols),
    htmltools::div(""),
    htmltools::div("Year"),
    htmltools::div("EOO area"),
    htmltools::div("Category")
  )
  
  data_row <- htmltools::div(
    style = sprintf(paste(
      "display: grid;",
      "grid-template-columns: %s;",
      "gap: 12px;",
      "align-items: center;",
      "padding: 8px 14px;"
    ), grid_cols),
    htmltools::HTML(status_circle(b1_row$Status)),
    htmltools::div(b1_row$Year),
    htmltools::div(b1_row$EOO),
    htmltools::div(b1_row$Category)
  )
  
  htmltools::div(
    style = paste(
      "margin: 12px 0;",
      "border: 1px solid #ddd;",
      "border-radius: 6px;",
      "overflow: hidden;",
      "background: white;"
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      style = paste(
        "padding: 10px 14px;",
        "background: #f0f0f0;",
        "border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;"
      ),
      htmltools::tags$b("B1"),
      htmltools::tags$span(
        " \u2014 Extent of Occurrence in the latest assessment year",
        style = "color: #555; font-size: 0.9em;"
      )
    ),
    header_row,
    data_row
  )
} else {
  ft <- flextable::flextable(b1_row)
  for (st in names(status_palette)) {
    rows_st <- which(b1_row$Status == st)
    if (length(rows_st) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::bg(ft, j = "Status", i = rows_st, bg = status_palette[[st]])
    }
  }
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(
    ft,
    caption = flextable::as_paragraph(
      flextable::as_b("B1 \u2014 "),
      "Extent of Occurrence in the latest assessment year"
    )
  )
  flextable::autofit(flextable::theme_booktabs(ft, bold_header = TRUE))
}
```
